items.title: Show HN: MuseLIVE – lossless-audio live streaming platform for musicians
items.desc: title: museLIVE description: Talk. Connect. Perform Live. image: https://static.clubmuse.live/assets/OGbanner.jpg The Ultimate Online Concert Platform for Musicians. Connect Musically and Create Income. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/en/app/museliveonlineconcerts/id1564042040) Transform live music experience Our mission is to transform the live music experience through high quality sound and intimate conversations while providing meaningful income with convenience and minimal upfront costs. What is museLIVE Here at museLIVE, we’re musicians too. We know how much high quality live music matters and we also value musicians’ extraordinary efforts that go into putting on a great live show. museLIVE Provides HighQuality Online Venue Deliver your music as you intended through lossless audio. Enjoy intimate concerts and connect with your fanbase at museLIVE. You deserve the best and so do your fans. Instant Monetization of Live Music Monetize your live performances. Generate immediate income through tickets and live music sales. museLIVE rewards you from the start. Only at museLIVE museLIVE Studio Perform with pro 16channel mixing interface with our complimentary software, museLIVE Studio. (Windows/macOS). Mix and deliver your music professionally. [Download](https://studio.muse.live/v2/museLIVEStudio%5Fv2.dmg) Intimate Relationships museLIVE offers a fun way to interact with your audience through a combination of voice and text interactions. Form intimate connections and tell your story. Live Concert NFTs All performances are effortlessly recorded while you are on stage. Fans can bid on different song NFTs. Create a memory you’ll own forever. Who we are We are musicians truly caring about Live Music. Ceo&Founder Taeho Oh Pianist VP at Dolby Built 0 to 1B+ users $3B+ value Wharton MBA & acoustics engineering Engineering Lead Rio Yeon Singersongwriter Head of Engineering of Syltare (P2E game) Achieved a top daily NFT volume at Opensea Amazon FAQs For Artists For Audience Members Must I understand crypto/blockchain to be involved? No museLIVE is built first and foremost for musicians, and we provide a seamless endtoend payment experience that is easy for fans and artists who have no prior background in cryptocurrencies. Having knowledge about crypto could help you understand how we make this work, but it is not necessary for most users. When will I get paid? We want to pay artists as soon as possible, and we are striving for End of Day(EOD) of the concert. Will my copyright be given away? Nope, NFTs are a snapshot of the performance and will not incur transferring of any copyright. That being said, having the necessary copyright to perform (as with any physical performance) is still required. Can I perform cover music? With the necessary licenses, yes museLIVE is currently working on getting a blanket license so all artists on museLIVE can perform freely. If you already have the necessary licenses to do so, yes as well Also, we cannot mint NFTs of cover music as it would infringe on the original artist’s copyright.🙂 COPYRIGHT museLIVE, INC. ALL RIGHTS RESERVED 2024 PRIVACY POLICYTERMS OF SERVICE[CONTACT](mailto:info.muse@muse.live)[INSTAGRAM](https://www.instagram.com/museliveofficial)

items.descZh: 这款每日歌词拼图游戏灵感来源于类似的文字游戏，旨在让用户通过重新排列打乱的单词来还原经典电影歌曲的歌词。游戏设有两种模式：Tamil 模式面向母语为泰米尔语的读者，Tanglish 模式则服务于能听懂泰米尔语但无法阅读其文字的用户。其核心亮点在于将音乐与语言学习巧妙结合，既考验玩家对歌词的记忆，又帮助泰米尔语学习者通过熟悉的电影歌曲来巩固语言能力，尤其适合在碎片化时间进行轻度娱乐与文化学习。

items.desc: description: Twitter GIF Downloader for public X posts. Paste a tweet URL, choose quality, and save MP4 or convert to a real .gif in your browser—free, no login. title: Twitter GIF Downloader & Converter – MP4 or GIF Twitee image: https://twitee.co/opengraph?title=Twitter%20GIF%20Downloader%20%26%20Converter%20%E2%80%93%20MP4%20or%20GIF%20%7C%20Twitee&description=Twitter%20GIF%20Downloader%20for%20public%20X%20posts.%20Paste%20a%20tweet%20URL%2C%20choose%20quality%2C%20and%20save%20MP4%20or%20convert%20to%20a%20real%20.gif%20in%20your%20browser%E2%80%94free%2C%20no%20login. tTwitee♥♥♥♥ Menu More Theme Dark Public post URL or ID Get GIF Free, no signup. Converts in your browser—nothing uploaded. No watermark. How to Download GIF from Tweet 1. Copy the public tweet link Copy a public X or Twitter post link that contains an animated GIF or video. 2. Find the available media Paste the link above and select Get GIF. 3. Choose GIF or MP4 Select the media item, then choose Download as GIF or Download as MP4. You can download a GIF from a tweet link without changing the original post. What Makes This Twitter GIF Downloader Different? Twitee is a Twitter GIF downloader for public posts that finds every available video or animatedGIF item in the original public post and any quoted post, instead of stopping at the first file. Paste an x.com, twitter.com, or Twitee post URL, or enter the numeric post ID. Each media card provides a clicktoplay preview without autoplay and lets you choose Best, High, Medium, or Low quality once for both outputs. Low reduces resolution and frame rate for a smaller, shareable GIF. Download MP4 keeps the selected source variant, while Convert to real .gif decodes that MP4 and encodes a looping GIF locally in your browser. The page shows fetching and conversion progress, then displays the final GIF size in MB before saving. GIF files have no audio and can be larger than MP4 files because the formats compress media differently. Browser conversion means the generated GIF is not uploaded to or stored by Twitee, although the public source MP4 must still be fetched for processing. Last verified: September 21, 2026. [X’s API documentation](https://docs.x.com/xapi/posts/englishlanguagefirehosestream) lists media type and variants among fields available for post media. Twitee uses the available MP4 variants rather than claiming quality the source does not provide. Download Tweet GIF Ordinary tweet videos are supported as well as X animated GIF media. GIF output has no audio, and conversion runs on your device. Larger dimensions, higher FPS, and longer duration need more CPU and memory, so browser and device limits still apply. Twitter GIF Converter Media shown as an animated GIF on X may be supplied as a looping MP4\. Twitee can keep the available MP4 or sample its frames into a real GIF. The MP4 is not necessarily the uploader's original file, and GIF palette reduction can change colors and increase file size. How to Save a Twitter GIF on an iPhone or Android In the X app, open the public post, tap Share, and copy its link. Open Twitee in Safari or Chrome, paste the link above, and select Get GIF. Choose a quality, then download the MP4 or convert it to a real .gif. On iPhone, the file normally appears in Files Downloads; on Android, check Files or the Downloads folder. Your browser settings may use a different location. Twitter GIF Not Downloading? Check the Post Link Use the URL of the individual public post, not a profile, search, or homepage link. Twitee accepts x.com, twitter.com, and Twitee post URLs or a numeric post ID. Protected, deleted, restricted, and imageonly posts cannot provide downloadable GIF or video media. If the post contains multiple media items or quotedpost media, Twitee lists each available video or GIF separately. Frequently Asked Questions Can I download a GIF from a tweet link? Yes. Paste a public X or Twitter post link, choose an available video or animated GIF, then select Download as GIF. Can I save a Twitter video as a GIF? Yes. Twitee can sample an available public tweet video into a real GIF in your browser. GIF output has no audio. How does the tweettoGIF converter work? Your browser reads the available MP4, extracts scaled frames, and encodes them into a looping GIF on your device. Why does Twitter provide an MP4 instead of a GIF? Media displayed as an animated GIF on X may be delivered as a looping MP4 because video compression is usually smaller and preserves more colors. Will a large video take longer to convert? Usually. Higher output dimensions, FPS, and duration require more CPU and memory. Conversion starts immediately after you choose a quality, and progress appears in the button. Does conversion upload my video to Twitee? Twitee's existing endpoint retrieves the public MP4 so your browser can read it. [](/Slaymish/theCity/blob/main/App/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/icon%5F128x128@2x.png) The City A macOS app that shows Claude Code runs as a city of robotstaffed offices. Every project folder is a building, every building has floors of robots, and every animation comes from a real event in the claude CLI's stream. The City starts its own Claude Code runs using the claude you already have installed, and they count towards your plan as usual. It doesn't show sessions you started in a terminal. [](/Slaymish/theCity/blob/main/Docs/Media/city.gif) Requirements macOS 26 or later. [Claude Code](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claudecode) 2.1.163 or later, installed and signed in. Older versions have known security issues and the app won't run jobs with them. The app looks for claude on your PATH and in ~/.local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin and ~/.claude/local. You can also point it at the binary in Settings. Before each job it checks that Claude Code is installed and signed in, and offers Install…, Locate… or Sign In… if not. Apple Intelligence enabled, for the ondevice model that picks departments and routes work. A wordoverlap check is used as a fallback. Install 1. Download the latest .dmg or .zip from [Releases](https://github.com/Slaymish/theCity/releases). 2. Drag TheCity.app into Applications. 3. The build is not notarised, so macOS blocks the first launch with "Apple could not verify…". Click Done, then open System Settings › Privacy & Security, scroll down and click Open Anyway. Or run: xattr dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/TheCity.app Updates The app uses [Sparkle](https://sparkleproject.org) to check for new releases and install them. To check straight away, choose The City › Check for Updates…. How it works [](/Slaymish/theCity/blob/main/Docs/Media/office.gif) City: each project folder is a building (File › New Project…, ⇧⌘N). items.descZh: theCity 是一款创新的原生 macOS 应用，它将 AI 编程助手 Claude Code 的运行过程转化为一个生动的、由机器人员工运营的虚拟办公室城市，为开发者提供了一种全新的、更具沉浸感的交互视角。在该应用中，每个项目文件夹被映射为一座建筑，建筑内的每一层代表一个特定的团队或任务，而屏幕上流动的每一个动画都实时对应着 Claude Code CLI 的真实事件。它能够自动启动本地已安装的 Claude Code 实例进行运算，且消耗的额度计入用户现有账户，同时深度集成 Apple Intelligence，利用设备端模型智能分配部门和路由任务，词重叠检查作为后备方案，确保任务流转的高效与精准。其独特的“信标”系统和“Needs you”列表能让用户迅速定位需要干预的项目，而 ⌘0 快捷键可一键返回宏观的城市全景。该应用要求 macOS 26 或更高版本，并支持 Claude Code 2.1.163 及以上版本，确保了运行环境的安全与稳定，特别适合同时管理多个复杂项目的开发者或技术团队，尤其是那些希望将枯燥的命令行监控转化为直观、游戏化视觉反馈，从而提升多任务并行处理效率和掌控力的用户。
